summary: WebRender received a large set of fixes and refactors focused on correctness, resource management, and profiling. Changes include better handling of rounding and gradients, tighter sprite-sheet sampling, improved clip/task ordering, and new Tracy profiler hooks (Tracy is the profiler integration used for low-level GPU/CPU timings). There are also Metal/ANGLE-specific driver-workarounds, more robust screenshot/readback behavior, and test tooling for different device pixel scales — together these reduce visual glitches and make rendering more stable and measurable for developers and users. _Mostly internal plumbing, but it directly reduces flicker, incorrect borders, and screenshot inconsistencies._
